Class DefaultCommandGateway

java.lang.Object
io.fluxzero.sdk.common.AbstractNamespaced<CommandGateway>
io.fluxzero.sdk.publishing.DefaultCommandGateway
All Implemented Interfaces:
Namespaced<CommandGateway>, CommandGateway, HasLocalHandlers
public class DefaultCommandGateway extends AbstractNamespaced<CommandGateway> implements CommandGateway
Default implementation of the CommandGateway interface.

This class delegates all functionality to an underlying GenericGateway instance, enabling the use of command gateway methods while leveraging the generic gateway's capabilities.

    • send

      public <R> CompletableFuture<R> send(Object payload, Metadata metadata, Guarantee guarantee)
      Description copied from interface: CommandGateway
      Sends a request with the given publication guarantee. The future represents its business response. Guarantee.DEFAULT uses fluxzero.publishing.defaultGuarantee, with the SDK major-version request default when unconfigured. Guarantee.NONE, Guarantee.SENT and Guarantee.STORED override publication for this call only; the business result is still awaited.
      Specified by:
      send in interface CommandGateway
      Type Parameters:
      R - response payload type
      Parameters:
      payload - request payload
      metadata - request metadata; use Metadata.empty() when none is needed
      guarantee - request publication guarantee
      Returns:
      the business response future
